Meet our Grapevine mommy-and-me sleep dress — a short-sleeve nightgown cut roomy and easy, finished with soft rose-pink raglan sleeves and a relaxed crew neckline. Breathable bamboo-cotton gauze keeps things light for warm-weather bedtimes, summer sleepovers, and cozy birthday mornings.

The watercolor print reads like a storybook vineyard: pretty grape clusters, curling vines, and scattered leaves in muted rose, plum, and sage. Wear it for pajama-party photos, a cottage weekend at grandma's, or a matching brunch moment on the back porch — and then tuck it straight into the overnight bag for holiday trips.

Key Features:

  • Breathable bamboo-cotton gauze: Airy double-gauze fabric that gets softer every wash.
  • Raglan short sleeves: Dusty-rose contrast sleeves for easy arm movement and sweet sunset-photo color.
  • Relaxed A-line silhouette: Roomy through the body with a swingy hem — comfy for toddlers to teens and mom too.
  • Matching mom + mini: Identical watercolor print in coordinating fits for a picture-perfect family moment.
  • Summer-weight sleepwear: Light enough for warm nights, layered-friendly for early-fall mornings.

Make every bedtime a matching moment — shop the Grapevine mommy-and-me set for brunch, birthdays, and back-to-school sleepovers.
